csv_project_name: DEV for Solana Affordable Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Solana Beach ( City ) owns a 1.08 acre piece of property located at 635 South Highway 101, SolanaBeach, CA 92075. The property currently houses its City Hall and public parking. The City is seeking to redevelop thissite and is soliciting proposals from developers ( Proposers ) to build very low- or low-income dwelling units and towork with the City to incorporate a new site for a City Hall. The Housing Element identies the Solana Beach City Hall site for possible development of 17 dwelling units up to 20du/ac and shall include a parking structure to provide parking for both City Hall and the new residential units. Thecombined development would result in a horizontal mixed-use development .
